{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the customer_age column has no missing values
assert sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum() == 0, "There are missing values in customer_age"

# Check for any invalid values (e.g., negative ages)
invalid_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] < 0]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = sales_df['customer_age'].mean()

invalid_ages, mean_age"}
